description: A direct INSERT of a second stock_records row with the same (sku, location) is rejected by the UNIQUE constraint on the real branch database
A direct INSERT into stock_records with a NULL sku is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint on the real branch database
A direct INSERT into stock_records with a NULL location is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint on the real branch database
A direct INSERT into stock_records with a NULL quantity is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint on the real branch database, while a NULL tracking_code is accepted
A direct INSERT into stock_records with quantity below zero is rejected by CHECK ck_stock_records_quantity_non_negative on the real branch database

Filing an existing (sku, location) through the repository upsert on the real branch database leaves exactly one row for the pair carrying the new quantity and tracking_code, scoped to the test's own unique sku

Downgrading the stock_records create migration to its own down_revision then upgrading head recreates the stock_records table with its columns, UNIQUE(sku, location) and CHECK(quantity >= 0) constraints (marked migration)
POST /api/stock with a negative quantity returns 422 naming the quantity field and stores no row for that pair on the paired branch
Filing the same (sku, location) twice leaves exactly one stock_records row for the pair carrying the second write's values
A re-file of an existing (sku, location) returns 200 with created=false, never a 4xx or 5xx
GET /api/stock with sku and location returns exactly that pair's record when other pairs exist
The integration test session fails before any test runs unless DATABASE_URL is a postgresql URL to the paired branch (not sqlite or in-memory)
Every /api endpoint declared in api_contracts (POST /api/stock, GET /api/stock, GET /api/locations) responds with Content-Type application/json and never text/html
